evidence.reason: The preview command fences only the output root and its systemd/launchd children against being inside git or the deploy checkout; it never checks that each resolved child remains inside the resolved preview output. A symlink at --output/systemd pointing to a live systemd unit directory is outside the checkout, so lines 909-912 accept it. The code comment at lines 907-908 states render_units and render_plists create and follow these children, and lines 922-923 write through the symlink, allowing preview to replace live unit files. The smallest compatible fix is to resolve and containment-check those children against the resolved --output before any write.
